constraints.name: card_merchant_corrections_card_txn_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (card_txn_id) REFERENCES card_transactions(card_txn_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: card_merchant_corrections_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (action = 'correct'::text AND corp_num IS NOT NULL AND corp_num ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'::text AND corp_num <> '0000000000'::text OR action = 'withdraw'::text AND corp_num IS NULL)

constraints.name: card_merchant_corrections_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM evidence)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM evidence)) <= 1000)

constraints.name: card_merchant_corrections_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 2000)

constraints.name: card_transactions_card_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (card_id) REFERENCES card_registry(card_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: finance_document_observations_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES finance_document_requests(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_group_revisions_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES finance_group_requests(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_group_revisions_withdrawal_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (withdrawal_reason IS NULL OR length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) <= 2000)

constraints.name: finance_same_revisions_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES finance_same_requests(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_same_revisions_withdrawal_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (withdrawal_reason IS NULL OR length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) <= 2000)

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_basis_json_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((finance_supply_keys(basis_json, ARRAY['schemaVersion'::text, 'subjectId'::text, 'subjectSnapshotText'::text, 'subjectSnapshotHash'::text, 'subjectIssues'::text, 'sources'::text, 'documents'::text, 'cReferences'::text]) AND (basis_json ->> 'schemaVersion'::text) = 'de0-supply-basis-v1'::text AND finance_supply_id(basis_json -> 'subjectId'::text) AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'subjectSnapshotText'::text) = 'string'::text AND (basis_json ->> 'subjectSnapshotHash'::text) ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'subjectIssues'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'sources'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'documents'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_typeof(basis_json -> 'cReferences'::text) = 'array'::text) IS TRUE)

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (preview_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND preview_hash = vat_followup_hash_v2(jsonb_build_object('draft', payload_json, 'basis', basis_json, 'assessment', assessment_json)))

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'recorded'::text AND withdrawal_reason IS NULL OR state = 'withdrawn'::text AND withdrawal_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(withdrawal_reason)) <= 2000)

constraints.name: finance_supply_review_revisions_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES finance_supply_review_requests(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_vat_use_dependencies_use_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (use_id) REFERENCES finance_vat_use_consumptions(use_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: finance_vat_use_effects_use_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (use_id) REFERENCES finance_vat_use_consumptions(use_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: transaction_links_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (relation = 'distinct'::text AND supply = 0 AND tax = 0 AND total = 0 OR relation = 'bank_invoice'::text AND supply = 0 AND tax = 0 AND total > 0 OR (relation = ANY (ARRAY['card_invoice'::text, 'manual_invoice'::text])) AND total > 0 AND (supply + tax) = total)

constraints.name: transaction_links_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'active'::text AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL OR state = 'cancelled'::text AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM cancel_reason)) > 0)

constraints.name: vat_filing_return_confirmation_return_id_basis_snapshot_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (return_id, basis_snapshot_id) REFERENCES vat_filing_return_revisions(return_id, basis_snapshot_id)

constraints.name: vat_filing_return_revisions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'basisSnapshotId'::text) IS NOT NULL AND ((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'basisSnapshotId'::text) = basis_snapshot_id)

constraints.name: vat_filing_return_revisions_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'scopeHash'::text) IS NOT NULL AND ((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'scopeHash'::text) = scope_hash)

constraints.name: vat_filing_return_revisions_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'calculationHash'::text) IS NOT NULL AND ((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'calculationHash'::text) = calculation_hash)

constraints.name: vat_filing_return_revisions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'version'::text) IS NOT NULL AND ((form_json -> 'filingBasis'::text) ->> 'version'::text) = schema_version)

constraints.name: vat_filing_subject_revisions_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'revisionId'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'revisionId'::text) = revision_id)

constraints.name: vat_filing_subject_revisions_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'subjectId'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'subjectId'::text) = subject_id)

constraints.name: vat_filing_subject_revisions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'version'::text) IS NOT NULL AND ((payload_json ->> 'version'::text)::integer) = version)

constraints.name: vat_followup_consumption_target
constraints.definition: CHECK (((basis_confirmation_id IS NOT NULL)::integer + (legacy_archive_id IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1 AND calculation_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND length(btrim(created_by)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(created_by)) <= 200)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_consumptions_revision_id_pair_line_no_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (revision_id, pair_line_no) REFERENCES vat_followup_review_pairs(revision_id, line_no)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_pairs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (past_origin = 'legacy'::text AND legacy_return_id IS NOT NULL AND past_basis_snapshot_id IS NULL AND past_fact_revision_id IS NULL OR past_origin = 'basis'::text AND legacy_return_id IS NULL AND past_basis_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND past_fact_revision_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_revisions_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'recorded'::text OR reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by = actor_user_id)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_revisions_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'schemaVersion'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'schemaVersion'::text) = schema_version)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_revisions_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'state'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'state'::text) = state)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_revisions_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (state = 'withdrawn'::text AND length(btrim(payload_json ->> 'withdrawalReason'::text)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(payload_json ->> 'withdrawalReason'::text)) <= 2000 AND (payload_json ->> 'withdrawalReason'::text) IS NOT NULL OR state <> 'withdrawn'::text AND payload_json ? 'withdrawalReason'::text AND (payload_json -> 'withdrawalReason'::text) = 'null'::jsonb)

constraints.name: vat_followup_review_revisions_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES vat_followup_review_requests(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
